screens.notes: Reuses the Button/Primary and Button/Destructive component sets already synced from DS-001 (see design/figma.manifest.json componentSets). Only the Medium/Pill/Default variant is needed for this pairing; the full variant matrix stays in the existing sheets. No new tokens or components are required — the existing .btn / .btn--primary / .btn--destructive / .btn--md / .btn--pill classes in apps/connect/styles.css already implement this exact variant, generated from the token paths listed above.
